name: discord-music-bot
description: Discord music bot with Spotify support

optionalDependencies._comment: Native-compiled performance upgrades. npm tries to build them; if a C compiler / Python / node-gyp isn't installed it silently skips and the JS fallbacks (opusscript + libsodium-wrappers) keep working. Linux + macOS usually 'just work'; Windows needs Visual Studio Build Tools (npm install --global windows-build-tools, OR install 'Desktop development with C++' from Visual Studio Installer). See scripts/install-native.js for one-shot setup.
